decisions.title: Source-session validity and revocation
decisions.owner: Fable Meta-CEO with existing technical/evidence owners
decisions.required_evidence: Current exact adapter and producer heads; actual emission/scheduling contract; accepted session and basis facts; next-session, late-emission, expiry, retraction and shortened-session cases.
decisions.required_output: Accepted source/observed/valid-for/expiry/revocation semantics, or proof of genuine current-session qualified production. Return to existing #7581 finding5789777976 without duplicating review.
decisions.forbidden_shortcut: Relabeling prior data as today, removing equality without a replacement validity rule, or translating compact UNKNOWN into FAIL.
decisions.technical_owners: Incumbent confluence and B4 policy/adapter owners, #7581
decisions.resolution_team: External source/entry specialist; independent integration reviewer; Fable adjudicates the versioned composition.
resolution_steps: Read the exact #7581 adapter, incumbent confluence producer, accepted session policy, emission receipts and original review carrier. First determine whether a genuine current-session predecision receipt exists; do not infer this from a scheduled workflow name.

If it exists, prove that receipt across actual normal and shortened sessions. If it does not, specify an explicit source-session to valid-decision-session interval with emission/knowledge cutoff, expiry, revocation and the owner responsible. The last completed session remains its actual source date.

Have the existing owner implement only the minimal versioned composition on the incumbent carrier after custody. Require old-session-valid, stale/expired, late-emitted, retracted, basis-mismatched, closed-session and compact-UNKNOWN cases.
Accept the exact native adapter-to-B4 behavior and subsequent normal-session proof. Until then, preserve an honest unavailable result and let independent research/UI work proceed.
decisions.completion_artifact: Accepted validity contract, exact source/head, independent review and real owner-chain evidence. No date relabeling, naked equality-check removal or invented PASS.

decisions.title: Independent expert anchors and episode admission
decisions.owner: Fable Meta-CEO with existing technical/evidence owners
decisions.required_evidence: Owner-native nomination and structural anchor; causal observation clock; exact identity and re-arm semantics; rejected-source/key examples; comparison with known killed species.
decisions.required_output: Versioned accepted source adapter and anchor contract with immutable episode lineage, suppression reasons and no changed historical IDs.
decisions.forbidden_shortcut: Ticker/date surrogate episodes, future extrema, silent retries of immutable source keys, or parallel lifecycle store.
decisions.technical_owners: B1/Stock Identity/TOI and relevant existing expert owners
decisions.resolution_team: External B1/identity/technical specialist with separate data-integrity reviewer.
resolution_steps: Inventory only the extra expert needed by the next capability. Preserve its raw nomination and suppression even when it cannot yet become a B1 episode.

Resolve the actual security/issuer identity and the source-owned structural anchor known at the original cutoff. Explicitly define competing anchors, multiple experts, rearm, event retraction and correction semantics.
Check semantic equivalence against the current kill registry. A renamed killed species is not a new experiment. Unknown or future-derived anchors do not qualify.

Extend the existing intake/episode contract through its owner, with deterministic source keys and immutable generations. Prove duplicate retries, later changed bytes, multiple listings and delayed knowledge. Existing board-row research may continue on its honest original grain.
decisions.completion_artifact: Accepted expert-to-B1 adapter and source/rearm contract, with suppression coverage. No ticker/date substitute, guessed low or retrospective new episode.

decisions.title: Real source histories and rights
decisions.owner: Fable Meta-CEO with existing technical/evidence owners
decisions.required_evidence: Exact usable dates, field semantics, vintage/correction lineage, coverage by original universe, delistings, publication/processing rights and source costs; data-independent domain criteria.
decisions.required_output: Signed-off source-readiness matrix and branch-specific admissible data classes. Industrial capital goods is a Cycle readiness candidate, not a return-selected winning domain.
decisions.forbidden_shortcut: Current membership/event set backdated, guessed statutory availability lags, broad industry series relabeled granular subthemes, or assumed licenses.
decisions.technical_owners: Existing Data OS, Earnings/FIF, GMI, quote and source licensing owners
decisions.resolution_team: External source-domain specialists; existing Data OS, Earnings/FIF, GMI and rights owners; Fable decides usable scope.
resolution_steps: For each first consumer, measure exact fields, semantic units, original population, dates, latency, revisions and failed/delisted coverage using metadata and source examples before strategy returns.

Classify each source branch as observed-as-run, admissible point-in-time replay, prospective-only or retrospective diagnostic. Record what cannot be reconstructed instead of manufacturing a statutory delay or assuming an API is historical.

Check actual rights for acquisition, processing, storage, model use and user redistribution separately. Credentials and subscriptions must come from the existing approved owner. Price or account labels do not imply a license.

Select the Cycle proving domain on this readiness basis. Missing contributor estimates holds the matched-revision branch, not issuer facts. No new paid commitment outside the approved envelope; take only that precise decision to the Chairman if necessary.
decisions.completion_artifact: A source-readiness matrix with exact admissible coverage and rights, per-branch consumer, fallback and proof; no backdated current membership/events.

decisions.title: Distinct strategy, entry and holding versions
decisions.owner: Fable Meta-CEO with existing technical/evidence owners
decisions.required_evidence: Frozen economic job, supported instruments, eligibility, horizons by role, exact owner facts, entry windows, invalidation and hold/review rules; unchanged legacy control.
decisions.required_output: Accepted sleeve definitions and separate policy versions; new 1D/4H entry and ER/CC management cannot be inferred from the EL control.
decisions.forbidden_shortcut: Changing labels under the singleton definition, horizon-as-hold inference, confluence waiver in an adapter or retroactive strategy relabeling.
decisions.technical_owners: Existing Prophet strategy/B4/plan owners and program acceptance
decisions.resolution_team: External strategy/B4/plan specialists; Fable owns policy design and program acceptance after independent challenge.
resolution_steps: State the economic mechanism, supported security classes, exact source species, origin, research horizon and holding horizon as separate roles. Preserve the current singleton control unchanged.
For the next lane, freeze its candidate eligibility, entry window, invalidation, expiry, add/reentry, next-event and hold law. Do not infer these from a UI name or the 2–15-session new-entry field.

Use the existing strategy/B4/management owners to version the new definition. New 1D/4H entry is an explicit strategy research change, not an adapter-only confluence waiver. No strategy silently mutates a legacy plan.

Separate source qualification, study registration, policy computation and permission to publish a recommendation. Keep the experimental label until the corresponding scientific and release evidence passes.
decisions.completion_artifact: An owner-accepted, testable strategy/entry/hold definition with versions and exact expected negative behavior. Fable resolves within-scope choices; no Astra approval.

decisions.title: Durable user decision/thesis mapping
decisions.owner: Fable Meta-CEO with existing technical/evidence owners
decisions.required_evidence: Actual supported write/read APIs and schema ownership; account/list/episode/security bindings; local/cloud distinction; retries, corrected generations, readback and independent portfolio checks.
decisions.required_output: Owner-compatible versioned mappings for Watch, Pass/reason, thesis/milestone and held-position links. Unsupported actions visibly remain unavailable until their owner exists.
decisions.forbidden_shortcut: A new Prophet personal store, turning a watch into a position, local-only notes advertised as cloud saved or unverified optimistic success.
decisions.technical_owners: Existing WatchStore, feedback, plan and Portfolio owners
decisions.resolution_team: External account/WatchStore/feedback/plan specialist with independent isolation and UX reviewer.
resolution_steps: Trace the actual existing WatchStore, feedback, plan and position APIs, schemas and account/list ownership. Inventory which requested actions persist remotely and which are local-only.

Map Watch, Pass/reason, thesis milestones and existing holdings to their real owner. Keep a source episode/generation reference while retaining corrected/current observations. Do not turn a symbol membership row into a second position ledger.

Extend the owning schema/adapter when an explicit capability is missing; use reversible migrations, current permission gates, account isolation and backward compatibility. Until then disable the unsupported action honestly.

Prove actual readback after save, duplicate retry reconciliation, changed list, different account, offline/partial response, corrected episode, deletion and portfolio-nonmutation. Document notes/local versus cloud behavior.
decisions.completion_artifact: A real persisted user journey and owner-compatible mapping. No optimistic-only success or fictional cross-device thesis.

decisions.title: Economic margins, endpoints and formal-read law
decisions.owner: Fable Meta-CEO with existing technical/evidence owners
decisions.required_evidence: User economic loss/coverage budget independent of held-out results; declared primary endpoint and cost assumptions; permitted pilot variability/dependence analysis; all comparisons/horizons/peeks counted.
decisions.required_output: Finite registered analysis with numerical minimum worthwhile gain/non-inferiority/coverage margins, uncertainty method, effective-information floor and read schedule before outcomes. Existing7751 remains separately controlled.
decisions.forbidden_shortcut: Nonsignificant harm presented as safety, 300rows treated as sufficient power, favorable horizon selection, duplicate cells credited as independent or unrestricted threshold search.
decisions.technical_owners: Existing Evaluation/QLedger with strategy and risk acceptance owners
decisions.resolution_team: External quantitative-design specialist plus independent statistics/risk reviewer; Fable is the final program scientific decision owner.
resolution_steps: Read the existing accepted evaluation protocol and trial ledger. Separate development/pilot evidence from untouched confirmatory or already-protected outcomes. Record all previously inspected eras and variants.

Select the economic quantity the user needs improved, realistic costs and review/coverage burden. Define the minimum worthwhile gain, maximum tolerated degradation and coverage floor from that job and permitted development evidence, not whichever holdout result later looks best.

Estimate variability/dependence using only the permitted pilot or historical development partition. Count dates, episodes, issuers and market cycles separately. Choose the uncertainty method and sufficient independent-information or precision requirements. If no defensible numeric margin can yet be set, commission that bounded design analysis instead of opening the holdout.

Before results, persist exact numeric margins, primary/supporting endpoints, population, benchmark, sample/landmark rules, model/policy variants, comparison family, multiplicity and formal-read schedule through the existing evaluation owner. Where existing law fixes an alpha/error rule or sample floor, preserve it; amendments are versioned and future-bound, not retroactive.

Obtain independent challenge, resolve it and authorize only the registered read under current Evaluation controls. A nonsignificant harm estimate is not non-inferiority. The #7751 aliases do not add sample/test credit; its 300-episode floor is not alone a power proof.

Record PASS, REJECT or INCONCLUSIVE against the frozen rule. A failed head stays shadow/absent or is replaced by a separately registered hypothesis. Do not cherry-pick a favorable horizon or ask Astra to make the verdict.
decisions.completion_artifact: A fully numeric, versioned, pre-outcome analysis and interpretation contract accepted by its existing owner. No universal invented win-rate target or permission for real-money risk.

decisions.title: Source and model-vintage eligibility
decisions.owner: Fable Meta-CEO with existing technical/evidence owners
decisions.required_evidence: Data release/observed/correction dates; model training and selection vintage where knowable; held-out partition and retrieval/extraction semantics.
decisions.required_output: Observed-as-run, point-in-time replay or retrospective designation for each study, with a prospective remedy when historical model knowledge cannot be established.
decisions.forbidden_shortcut: Date-filtered retrieval treated as proof modern model weights contain no future knowledge; masking alone treated as certification.
decisions.resolution_team: External temporal-data/model-validation specialist; Fable decides the admissible claim.
resolution_steps: Pin the input body/revision and its source, observation and correction clocks. A document published before a cut but captured after it is not observed-as-run evidence.

Pin feature code, fitting data cutoff, normalization, model training/selection vintage and calibration. Current date-filtered retrieval does not prove a modern model has no later knowledge in its weights.

Label unknown historical model knowledge as retrospective or use an admissible model vintage and explicit replay assumptions. Start a frozen prospective study where historical provenance cannot establish the intended claim.
Add real late-capture, corrected-body, current-only event-set, future membership, overlap and fitting-label-maturity tests. Keep the original forecast distinct from later landmarks.
decisions.completion_artifact: Per-study evidence class and model/source eligibility, with tested leakage controls and no hidden future knowledge claim.

decisions.title: Fill, costs, latency and capacity assumptions
decisions.owner: Fable Meta-CEO with existing technical/evidence owners
decisions.required_evidence: Executable side or approved cost floor, first usable decision time, session/bar anchoring, limit-order evidence, halt/delisting treatment and measured/floor/unknown status.
decisions.required_output: Versioned fill/cost contract and sensitivity tests; no capacity claim until actual position/liquidity assumptions are evaluated.
decisions.forbidden_shortcut: Same-bar known-close fill, touch-equals-fill, twice-charged spread, missing quote treated as zero cost or a stop assumed guaranteed.
decisions.technical_owners: Existing quote/basis/B4/Evaluation owners; Portfolio/Risk for capacity
decisions.resolution_team: External quote/basis/market-structure/Evaluation specialists; Portfolio/Risk retains capital authority.
resolution_steps: Choose one reproducible execution convention for the specific research policy using actual decision/observation latency and accepted session/bar anchoring. Distinguish replay assumptions from observed fills.

Use quote-side prices or midpoint plus a spread allowance, never both. Document fees, slippage, missing-NBBO fallback and coverage. A limit touch does not establish a fill; a same-bar known close is not a prior executable price.

Bind basis/corporate actions, suspension, missing bars, delisting and barrier-order uncertainty. Preserve unknown outcomes rather than converting them to cash. Run sensitivity using a declared cost range before promotion.

Evaluate size/capacity only through existing Portfolio/Risk with its actual assumptions. A signal or policy study does not authorize sizing, leverage or trades. If capacity is unmeasured, limit the published claim.
decisions.completion_artifact: A versioned fill/cost/latency and outcome treatment with measured/estimated/unknown fields and independent realism review.

decisions.title: Visual architecture and user comprehension
decisions.owner: Fable Meta-CEO with existing technical/evidence owners
decisions.required_evidence: Current shared components, design tokens and route inventory; dark/light EN/ZH1440/390 examples; empty/invalidated/degraded/uncertain states and user tasks.
decisions.required_output: Accepted visual packet and task-based comprehension criteria, including experimental versus live authority and new-entry versus held-position distinctions.
decisions.forbidden_shortcut: A third header/token family, CSS skin swap counted as both art directions, or attractive mocks treated as production proof.
decisions.technical_owners: Existing design-system/product owners and independent design reviewer
decisions.resolution_team: External design/product specialist and independent visual/comprehension reviewer; Fable approves direction.
resolution_steps: Read the existing product design doctrine, component registry and current route. Preserve its two global nav families and shared tokens; do not make a rival dashboard design system.

Freeze the task flow, information hierarchy and user-visible vocabulary for all six views and three sleeves. Explicitly distinguish source facts, estimates, research/control status, current entry and held-position management.

Produce dark and light as deliberate designs with EN/ZH desktop/mobile and empty/degraded/corrected/invalidated/uncertain variants. Fable resolves taste decisions after external critique; no compulsory Astra design council.

Define representative task-based acceptance: find a displaced candidate, understand a refusal, save to the correct list, recover the original thesis, distinguish sleeve/holding meaning, and read the honest record. Independent users/reviewer must not infer a trade occurred from a watch click.
decisions.completion_artifact: Accepted design packet, required captures and comprehension tests under the existing design/evidence owners, not mockup-only acceptance.

decisions.title: Exact source custody, worker admission and independence
decisions.owner: Fable Meta-CEO with existing technical/evidence owners
decisions.required_evidence: Current operation/Attempt state, writer leases and effect uncertainty; original review carrier; eligible capability and budget; exact immutable packet.
decisions.required_output: One admitted source-authoritative operation per unit, least-scarce capable route, qualified independent reviewer and durable return path.
decisions.forbidden_shortcut: A plan mistaken for dispatch, replacing a STARTed/unknown effect, Fable default placement or raw provider-spawn fallback.
decisions.technical_owners: Existing Executive Capacity/Runtime, source writer, routing and review owners
decisions.resolution_team: Existing Runtime/Capacity/source-custody owners; Fable orchestrates only eligible external routes.
resolution_steps: Discover the actual installed accepted fabric interface and current supported schemas. The named architecture in this package is not runtime proof. Read actual operation/Attempt, writer lease and original reviewer state.

Bind the child to one existing carrier, exact source grant, budget and return path. Verify external-only placement and that neither author nor native built-in subagent will satisfy the review slot. Do not insert invented policy fields into an API.

Start only when all applicable gates clear, then preserve same-carrier effect truth. A timeout produces reconciliation, not a duplicate branch, provider or operation key. Any PRESTART_REBIND requires positive no-START/no-effect evidence.

When routes are unavailable, test other accepted external routes once per changed capability generation, continue independent principal work and escalate only the actual infrastructure/permission gate to its owner. Do not force the Chairman into routine account allocation or return to Astra.
decisions.completion_artifact: Native admission/custody/placement/return evidence, with exact operator identity and independent reviewer. Documents alone grant no runtime execution.

decisions.title: Release, telemetry and safe rollback
decisions.owner: Fable Meta-CEO with existing technical/evidence owners
decisions.required_evidence: Current production-path artifacts, entitlement and account matrix, actual ordinary refresh, version-compatible last-good state and user-action preservation.
decisions.required_output: Accepted staged-release/rollback packet with declared freshness and field performance budgets; current quote-state reevaluation after any rollback.
decisions.forbidden_shortcut: Serving a stale green entry card from last-good cache, destructive user-store resets, or CI green treated as acceptance.
decisions.resolution_team: Existing release/auth/publication/monitoring owners; independent production reviewer; Fable owns the in-scope release decision.
resolution_steps: Bind exact source, model, policy, schema and accepted input artifacts to the serving path. Identify the actual release mechanism, entitlement path, private logs/evidence, and rollback control from current source; do not guess URLs or credentials.

Perform staged integration and actual entitled/unentitled browser journeys. Separate component proof, simulated auth, deploy success and served-byte behavior. Record the version the user actually saw.
Prove same-date correction, stale/expired mandatory inputs, saved state, ordinary next refresh and compatible rollback. Rollback cannot serve an obsolete green entry or erase user/grade history.

Set current operating budgets and incident ownership through existing monitors. Fable may accept release when independent evidence satisfies the contract; unresolved formal account/credential/new-spend ceremonies go directly to their genuine owner.
decisions.completion_artifact: A release/rollback and natural-refresh proof bundle with exact accepted and served versions. No green-CI-as-production shortcut.

decisions.title: Final US capability and claim boundary
decisions.owner: Fable Meta-CEO with existing technical/evidence owners
decisions.required_evidence: All advertised US persona tasks, three initial sleeve dispositions, independent scientific/mechanical/product evidence, actual limitations and remaining scope.
decisions.required_output: Explicit accepted launch claims and ongoing obligations. Failed research is rejected honestly; further sleeves/regions require their own accepted work and do not disappear silently.
decisions.forbidden_shortcut: A research prototype called a complete flagship, fabricated positive evidence, copying US coefficients to other markets or hiding a promised missing capability.
decisions.resolution_team: Fable Meta-CEO performs delegated program acceptance after independent product/science/release review; Chairman remains final authority.
resolution_steps: Trace every R5 requirement and every advertised capability to actual evidence, live authority and remaining limitations. Preserve all 29 build and 24 research dispositions, not only the first three PRs.

Require each initial sleeve to be useful at its stated scientific/entry/hold authority. A rejected model may remain absent and the control may remain live, but a promised missing capability remains an obligation rather than a silent scope cut.

Distinguish a useful phased launch from the full flagship. Check real user tasks, complete candidate visibility, original/current thesis, account persistence, honest outcomes, operating reliability, normal refresh and rollback.

Fable signs the supported in-scope acceptance and launch claims without a further Astra approval. Take only actual material scope expansion/removal or reserved legal/financial authority to the Chairman. Preserve region-native adaptation as next scope after US, not an excuse to leave US unfinished.
decisions.completion_artifact: An evidence-bound full/partial acceptance decision and exact remaining obligations; no synthetic/test counts or unknown performance inflated into completion.
